items.title: Starting tomorrow (Oct. 1), Onyeka Okongwu is eligible for a contract extension up to 3 years and $76.6 million total.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Starting tomorrow (Oct. 1), Onyeka Okongwu is eligible for a contract extension up to 3 years and $76.6 million total.

It's a short window, though.

Only eligible to extend until Oct. 19, then the door closes again.

(In contrast, Lu Dort is extension-eligible all season)
